## QuantumScape Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Business Results and Webcast


October 8, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.quantumscape.com/node/12871/pdf)


SAN JOSE, Calif., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[QuantumScape Corporation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=raTwB-U01ZWMenjZUTunKOCurd8aP9xGpDY6QAhOdQhLaLaGl-DAsAxPgbZ91r0-EL9BlC5a42GNrb9Z9l5cOJvRN_QTWB1hFHUM9QplQRI=) (NASDAQ: QS), a global leader in next-generation solid-state lithium-metal battery technology, today announced it will release its 2026 third-quarter business results after market close on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. This will be followed by a conference call at 2 p.m. Pacific Time (5 p.m. Eastern Time).


Starting today, October 8, shareholders can submit questions ([here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=EgcLfWBKEIAnPSLXb1bDR14gwa2KX_fFSt5LIozkgvs-wQWd0KPXrgnPHaNvJwE7CA9f5BNm_U17uJUwmrQHmHc5_NxDTIqy8fJFRfqMqILI7n9iDVf-ei8j9U5lm5L24C161jsjcfXgsV5l0Ml55Q==) ) they would like addressed on the call. QuantumScape management will respond to a selection of the submitted questions. The company will accept questions until Tuesday, October 20, at 2 p.m. Pacific Time (5 p.m. Eastern Time).


The call will be accessible live via a webcast on QuantumScape’s[IR Events Calendar page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VPNr4oOuGKsCzWB94Xv8J06fpQGQ9r7aVlc4frj5EncLtBwMCKL1HdCn0A2eDdz0EajLoKm76jQ3ZR43kQDNs6BhdNyLuRPYv2KYhGv9Y7N4Ohe_alvOQiWFfjH5ETNC) . An archive of the webcast will be available shortly after the call for 12 months.


**About QuantumScape Corporation**


QuantumScape is on a mission to revolutionize energy storage to enable a sustainable future. The company’s next-generation batteries are designed to enable greater energy density, faster charging and enhanced safety to support the transition away from legacy energy sources toward a lower carbon future. For more information, visit[www.quantumscape.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dno6RobzmKkSKSVUDJqUBTLdgCJYIR14Q0RKfJvDmS1y-cY19ACJdiDSHtf2IxLq7Op4ItEhO64HFCxF0qYtXb8Wqh-5UHu1AFblN_jxyNo=) .
